# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 20 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 20:6 — struck him on the neck — Benjamin's blow

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "struck him with it on his neck" | Literal eis ton trachēlon |
| LOGOS | "struck him on the neck with it" | Transposed for English flow |
| PNEUMA | "struck him on the neck with it" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA transposition is cleaner. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 20:7 — render evil for evil vs. repay evil with evil

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "render evil for evil" | Literal antapodounai kakon anti kakou |
| LOGOS | "render evil for evil" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "repay evil with evil" | Slight variation |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET and LOGOS agree on 'render evil for evil.' This is the standard biblical formulation. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
